weakness: No account procedure, approvals, or reviews; five shared logins; shared passwords unchanged after a March 2026 departure
remediation_plan: Joiner and leaver checklists; named accounts everywhere except the smokehouse PIN (recorded exception); monthly reconciliation
milestones: 2026-08-12 shared passwords and PIN changed, former worker's dashboard login removed; 2026-09-30 checklists in use; 2026-10-31 named accounts and first reconciliation
resources_required: Office Manager time (1 hour a month); MSP labor (about 2 hours)

weakness: Always-on smokehouse portal connection and unattended remote desktop tool with no authorization, MFA, or logging
remediation_plan: Both paths off by default and enabled per job (done 2026-08-12); named vendor accounts with MFA or removal of the remote desktop tool; maintenance log of every session
milestones: 2026-08-12 supervised sessions only; 2026-09-30 vendors asked for named accounts; 2026-10-31 MFA on the portal and tool replaced
resources_required: Staff time; possible vendor fee for named accounts

weakness: Floor users share the records app and labeling PC logins; entries and changes not attributable
remediation_plan: Named records app accounts with short PINs on the tablets; named logins on the labeling PC; typed initials replaced by account names
resources_required: Records app per-user fee (about $15 a user a month); MSP labor

weakness: Firewall, backup console, records app administrator, and smokehouse portal accept a password alone
remediation_plan: MFA on all four; MSP sends screenshots; separate named MSP accounts instead of one shared administrator
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on firewall and backup console; 2026-10-31 records app and portal

remediation_plan: 30-minute annual session for all 7 employees with a plant section (machine screens, labels, monitoring gone quiet); invoice fraud module for the Office Manager; quarterly phishing simulations for email users; reporting card at every station
milestones: 2026-09-30 reporting cards posted; 2026-11-30 first session; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: Records and logs can be deleted or edited without detection
remediation_plan: Remove the vendor default administrator; two named administrators; cook logs exported as read-only PDFs with a file hash; controller log export after every cycle; records integrity procedure
milestones: 2026-10-31 named administrators; 2026-11-30 PDF exports; 2026-12-31 integrity procedure signed

weakness: Inventory lists 3 of 17 networked devices and no SaaS services
source: P07 network scan 2026-08-11; P03 CSF ID.AM-01
remediation_plan: One-page inventory with firmware, owner, connections, and data held (POL-04 4.4); updated at every change
resources_required: Office Manager and Maintenance and Sanitation Technician time

weakness: No contingency plan; manual monitoring and records fallbacks unwritten
remediation_plan: Short contingency plan from the BIA: downtime binder (manual temperature log, paper CCP and SSOP forms, pre-printed labels, contact card), hurricane checklist, recovery order
milestones: 2026-10-31 downtime binder in the production office; 2026-11-30 plan approved by the owner

remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder, the label templates, and a month of cook-log exports; quarterly restore tests; annual tabletop using the P08 runbook; one manual-monitoring drill a year
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2026-12-31 second restore test

weakness: Machine settings not backed up; backups not immutable; one login can delete them
remediation_plan: 90-day immutable retention; export smokehouse cycles, stuffer HMI settings, and packager recipes after each approved change to an offline USB drive in the safe and to the restricted folder
milestones: 2026-09-30 first machine setting exports; 2026-10-31 immutable retention

weakness: No security terms or oversight for the MSP, equipment vendors, records app, or AI camera vendor
remediation_plan: Vendor list; MSP contract amendment (incident notice within 24 hours, 4-hour recovery commitment, MFA on its logins); security terms at each renewal; yearly SOC 2 or security summary review
milestones: 2026-08-20 cold-chain SOC 2 reviewed; 2026-11-30 records app vendor report requested; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment signed

weakness: One flat network; any outbound connection allowed; 7-day firewall logs
remediation_plan: Plant VLAN for machines, labeling PC, tablets, gateway, and AI camera; allow only listed outbound destinations and the label data path; 90-day firewall logs

weakness: Malware alerts seen only in business hours; no behavior-based detection
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting on the 3 managed PCs; alerts to the Office Manager by text

weakness: Manufacturer default administrator password on the smokehouse controller web interface (found during SC-7 testing; IA-5 was not one of the 13 selected controls)
remediation_plan: Password changed the same day and sealed (done); check the packager, stuffer HMI, gateway, and AI camera for default passwords
milestones: 2026-08-11 smokehouse password changed; 2026-09-30 other devices checked
